**📅 September 10, 2026**
**📊 Market Sentiment:** Bearish
**🎯 Confidence:** High

**🧠 Key Themes**
• Oil shock above $100/bbl and escalating US-Iran military conflict are repricing inflation expectations across assets
• Treasury yields surging to multi-year highs as markets pivot to pricing potential Fed rate hikes, not cuts
• US-Canada trade war escalation adding supply-chain pressure alongside Middle East supply risks

**⚠️ Notable Risks**
• Direct US-Iran military escalation threatening Hormuz supply routes and global shipping
• Fed policy error risk if oil forces hiking into an already yield-stressed, slowing economy
• Treasury buyback disappointment failing to anchor long-end yields, accelerating the bond selloff

**📈 Volatility Outlook:** Rising

**🧾 One-Line Take**
An oil-driven inflation shock, escalating Iran war, and surging Treasury yields are forcing a rapid repricing of Fed policy and equity risk, pushing markets into a volatility expansion regime that demands caution from options sellers.
